storage: Refrigerate after opening in a clean, dry, closed jar and use a clean dry spoon; use within the time on the label (homemade paste keeps about a month in the fridge or six months or longer in the freezer, per masalaandchai).
looksLike: A pale beige, smooth paste with a sharp smell, sold in pouches and jars; usually ginger and garlic with salt and an acidity regulator.
howToPick: Read the label: ginger and garlic should come first, followed by salt and an acidity regulator; some brands also add preservatives such as E211 or E202 (Onmanorama). Look for an FSSAI licence number, a manufacturing date and a batch number.
shelfLife: Unopened pouches or jars keep for months; check the date printed.
substitutes: Ginger paste plus garlic paste separately
Dry ginger and garlic powder (¼ tsp each)
